description: Find the Evendo ID of a country, region, city or neighbourhood by name. Always call this first: other tools take place IDs, not names. Names can be ambiguous (several 'Soho's), so check address_city / country_code in the results and pick the right one. If you don't know what kind of place it is, omit place_type.

place_type.description: Cities for cities, Neighbourhoods for districts, CountryRegions for regions like Scotland or Bavaria (if none found, try Regions, then omit place_type), Destinations for destination areas, Country for countries.

name: resolve_place
title: Resolve a place name
